thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Dedicated pool 'enterprise-resv-us-east-1' utilization 100% for 7m, queue length rising > 4200. Autoscaler attempts failing (rate-limit). Pager routed to #incidents and oncall.
Maya (oncall): grabbing. tagging @Derek and @Sasha. any live customer impact reported?
Derek (infra): seeing large queue growth to GPU scheduler, multiple tenants pegged. autoscaler logs show 'ScaleUpRejected: quota/exceeded' and 429 from cloud quota service. posting quick logs:
```
[2026-03-15T02:07:10Z] pool=enterprise-resv-us-east-1 queue=4287 active_gpus=128 reserved=128
[2026-03-15T02:07:12Z] autoscaler: request_scale +64 -> denied: account_quota 128/128
[2026-03-15T02:08:01Z] scheduler: eviction_candidates tenant=fastcorp sessions=421
```
Sasha (eng-runtime): noisy-tenant signature matches FairShare anomaly: fastcorp has a sudden long-run interactive session spike. KV cache growth too. We can try prefix eviction and session throttling for noisy tenants.
Maya (oncall): Prod impact? any 5xx increase or customer bridges?
ProdOps: monitoring shows elevated latency for 2 enterprise customers (FastCorp & GreenLeaf). No 500s yet but timeouts on start-of-inference requests rising. Helen (acct-mgr) on standby.
Helen (acct-mgr): preparing to message FastCorp & GreenLeaf if we need to do evictions; let me know ETA on mitigation.
Maya (oncall): plan ideas: 1) enable emergency burst (if cloud quota allows) 2) evict long-running sessions for noisy tenant(s) 3) toggle routing to best-effort shared pool for non-enterprise routes 4) open customer bridge if impact confirmed. Thoughts?
Derek (infra): cloud quota is at account limit for region. emergency burst requires approvals; can try cross-region fallback to enterprise-resv-us-west-2 if latency acceptable. Can we cold-shift some sessions?
Sasha (eng-runtime): quick ops we can do now: - enforce per-tenant connection cap (soft reject new sessions) - drop KV cache for tenants over threshold - apply temporary fairshare weighting so no single tenant >40% of pool. I'll push a config patch: `runtime.fairshare.limit = 0.4` and `session.max_concurrent = 50` for enterprise pool.
Maya (oncall): do the config patch, Sasha—do it as a canary to 2 nodes first. I'll start the bridge with FastCorp AEs; Helen please join.
Sasha (eng-runtime): pushing canary now, logs:
```
PATCH /config/pools/enterprise-resv-us-east-1 {"fairshare_limit":0.4, "session_max":50}
Apply -> canary nodes 2/128 ok
```
Sasha (eng-runtime): canary success, rolling to 20% of pool. Observing queue drop in canary shards to ~420.
Maya (oncall): good. Derek, can you initiate cross-region routing for non-latency-sensitive queued jobs to us-west-2? Add a fallback policy for tenants tagged `noncritical`?
Derek (infra): started flow: `rbctl route set --pool enterprise-resv-us-east-1 --fallback enterprise-resv-us-west-2 --selector noncritical`
Derek (infra): cloud inter-region quotas will still count but reduces per-region pressure. watch for 502s.
ProdOps: queue length overall dropping from 4287 -> 1980 after the fairshare rollout + fallback routing started. client timeouts still high for some in-flight sessions.
Helen (acct-mgr): on bridge with FastCorp. They confirm degraded start latency and some failures. They've paused large-batch internal jobs temporarily. Asking for ETA to restore normal.
Maya (oncall): next step: evict runaway sessions from tenants flagged by scheduler. Sasha, can you run eviction for sessions > 30m and >8k tokens in the reservation pool? We'll exclude any sessions with 'longjob' tag flagged by customer.
Sasha (eng-runtime): running `runtimectl evict --pool enterprise-resv-us-east-1 --tenant fastcorp --age 30m --tokens 8k --dry-run` output shows 332 sessions eligible. Proceed?
Maya (oncall): proceed. mark for pre-notice and immediate eviction: `evict --now`. Helen, notify FastCorp we are terminating long-running sessions to restore capacity.
Helen (acct-mgr): sending brief to FastCorp now: "We're proactively terminating long-running sessions to restore capacity; please avoid resubmitting large jobs until we confirm stabilization."
Sasha (eng-runtime): eviction in progress. Evicted 318 sessions from fastcorp. Observed burst of free GPU slots ~+42. queue now 1180.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Action log: evicted 318 fastcorp sessions; fairshare limit applied; fallback routing to us-west-2 enabled.
Maya (oncall): good. any errors from autoscaler?
Derek (infra): autoscaler still showing `ScaleUpRejected: quota/exceeded` for region, but effective pool utilization dropping to 82% after actions. If we sustain under 85% for 15m, we can avoid additional evictions.
ProdOps: latency moving back toward baseline for GreenLeaf; FastCorp still on degraded but recovering. No broad customer impact beyond reduced start-of-inference for those two.
Maya (oncall): decision: keep fairshare limit and session cap for 60m, monitor. Open a follow-up ticket to engage cloud quota team for increasing regional capacity. Sasha, capture config diff and rollback plan.
Sasha (eng-runtime): captured: `PATCH id=bf7e3; revert via PATCH id=bf7e3.revert` and created runbook note `evict-long-running` with command examples.
Helen (acct-mgr): FastCorp acknowledged temporary mitigation, appreciate heads-up. Scheduling postmortem call with them tomorrow.
Maya (oncall): creating incident ticket and will assign Sev2. Summary: root cause noisy-tenant long-running sessions + cloud quota limit prevented autoscaler from adding capacity. Mitigation: targeted evictions, temporary fairshare, cross-region fallback. Follow-ups: quota increase request, longer-term fairshare enforcement, improved autoscaler error handling and graceful degradation routes.
ProdOps: will keep monitoring, posting 15m updates.
Ops-bridge-bot: Bridge opened: https://bridge.internal/redwood/1719502468 (participants: Maya, Derek, Sasha, Helen, ProdOps)
Maya (oncall): thanks all. I'm going to hand off to Derek for overnight watch. Derek, please escalate if utilization trends back toward 90% or if more than 2 enterprise tenants show degradation.
Derek (infra): taking handoff. will monitor and escalate.
Maya (oncall): end of thread, creating postmortem doc stub now. :memo:
